name: @kiwa-test/orm
description: ORM query test adapter for kiwa — setup Drizzle environments against either in-memory SQLite (v0.1, mock mode) or a real Postgres / MySQL started by testcontainers (v0.2 live mode), apply migrations, seed fixtures, and assert query results with consistent shape (Prisma + Kysely planned for v0.3)

scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
scripts.test:cov: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node --coverage --coverage.provider=v8 --coverage.reporter=json --coverage.reporter=json-summary --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/index.js' --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/setup-orm-env.js' --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/expectations.js' --coverage.exclude='.vitest-dist/tests/**'
